contract.name: Marco
contract.goal: Gran fondo, 120 km with 2,000 m climbing
contract.notes: Indoor trainer on weekdays, outdoor on weekends.

plan.week_summary: Taper week for Marco ahead of the Gran Fondo. Overall volume is reduced to 350 minutes to shed fatigue while keeping intensity sharp with one short interval opener session on Tuesday. Weekday rides stay on the indoor trainer and weekend rides move outdoors.

days.title: Complete Rest Day
days.purpose: Allow baseline recovery and kick off the taper week fresh.
days.structure: Full rest day, gentle mobility, and hydration.

days.title: Indoor Taper Openers
days.purpose: Maintain high-end neuromuscular sharpness and leg speed without fatigue.
days.structure: 15 min easy spin warm-up, 4 x 2 min at race threshold pace with 2 min easy recovery, 5 x 30 sec high cadence efforts with 90 sec easy, 15 min cool down.

days.title: Indoor Recovery Spin
days.purpose: Promote blood flow and aerobic maintenance.
days.structure: 50 min easy spin in Zone 1-2 on indoor trainer at 90+ RPM.

days.title: Indoor Steady Endurance
days.purpose: Maintain endurance engine while keeping stress minimal.
days.structure: 10 min warm-up, 40 min steady Zone 2 aerobic riding, 10 min cool down.

days.title: Complete Rest Day
days.purpose: Rest legs for the outdoor weekend ride and upcoming race week.
days.structure: Full rest day, light foam rolling, and race logistics prep.

days.title: Outdoor Taper Long Ride
days.purpose: Maintain outdoor bike handling and aerobic conditioning in a reduced-volume package.
days.structure: 120 min easy Zone 2 outdoor ride on rolling terrain, capping efforts on any climbs.

days.title: Outdoor Easy Aerobic Spin
days.purpose: Keep legs light and test race equipment and nutrition.
days.structure: 60 min easy Z1-Z2 spin on flat outdoor roads with 3 x 15 sec cadence accelerations.
